scope: TE-03 candidate-utility targets and model vintages only; no engine economic look

support.reason: the registered support floor of 20 informative candidate episodes is not met by 8 evaluable outer targets; a coverage extension is required rather than moving any origin, cell or train window

extension_rule: a spec whose target_series.end or model_series.end exceeds this registered end_exclusive must be planned with --coverage pointing at a regime_lab.te_coverage_revision.v1 artifact; the revision must restate this prior coverage, keep the 28-day grid and 28-day target horizon, extend the target series contiguously from last_origin + 28 days, recompute the model series from the registered model start, and leave alpha/cell/bank/economics unchanged
prohibited: moving an existing origin, cell or train window
changing the 28-day grid or the 28-day target horizon
changing alpha, cell, candidate bank or economics
using later data for an earlier origin
zero-filling an unavailable or budget-stopped target
